description_en: Defines the scope of monitoring data to export and returns the Cursor parameter for the initial call to the BatchGet operation
description_zh: 定义导出监控数据的范围并返回用于初始调用BatchGet接口的Cursor参数
kebab_example: aliyun cms-export cursor --namespace acs_ecs_dashboard --metric cpu_idle --period 60 --start-time 1641627000000 --end-time 1641645000000 --matchers Operator=EQUALS Label=userId Value=1208863178610000 --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.description_en:
The start timestamp.

Unit: milliseconds.

> Because monitoring data in CloudMonitor is retained for only 90 days, the interval between the start time and the current time should be no more than 90 days.

The key of the metric dimension.

The metric dimension is in the format of a collection of key-value pairs, for example, `instanceId:i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****` or `userId:120886317861****`.

For information about how to obtain the dimensions of a metric, see the `Dimension` parameter in [Cloud service metrics](~~163515~~).
